simple.inThisVerse: The selected word is tied to נְהִיר (H5094) in the Hebrew source text. Part of speech: n-m.
simple.whyItMatters: This word appears 4 times in the Hebrew Bible, so BibleIQ can compare how Scripture uses it across multiple passages.
simple.summary: נְהִיר (nᵉhîyr) means illumination , i.e. (figuratively) wisdom First listed occurrence: Dan 2 22.

definitions.full: H5094. nhiyr [ נְהוֺר נְהִיר, ] noun masculine light ( נְהוֺרָא ᵑ7 , Syriac ; see Biblical Hebrew II. נהר ); — emphatic נהירא Kt, < נְהוֺרָא Qr (compare ᵑ7 Syriac; Nö LCB 1896, 703 ) Dan 2:22 . נַהִירוּ (K §§ 16. 5; 61, 4 ) noun feminine illumination, insight (Syriac id. ); — absolute Dan 5:11 , 14 (both + חָכְמָה שָׂכְלְתָנוּ, ).
definitions.rootNote: (Aramaic) or נְהִירוּ ; (Aramaic), from the same as 5105 ;
